text_block_list.text:
After Mejiro Ryan and Mejiro McQueen's 
joint training run—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that felt great! I feel like I could 
go for another lap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Your final spurt before the finish 
line was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely won't lose"... You could 
feel that fighting spirit in her powerful 
running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!? Ehehe, thank you! It makes me 
really happy to hear you say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I just really don't want to look 
uncool in front of the people who put 
their trust in me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When I think of that, power just wells 
right up inside me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So she's fired up because she wants to 
look good in front of her Trainer? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Kh—?! I-It's not like that at all, look!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You're always working so hard for my 
sake, so... I really want to live up to 
that...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I-I got all warmed up from 
running!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go let this cool down a bit--!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Goodness. I'm almost feeling a 
little jealous.
